title: Continuum Retention Reduction of ClearPath Exit Fees
content:
**Reduction clause.** The backup-retention reduction of the early termination fee of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement reads the term end date of the client's active Continuum Backup & Recovery plan and counts the calendar days from the termination effective date to it: 365 days or more take 5.0 percent off; zero up to 364 days take 2.5 percent off; a plan ending before the termination effective date, or no active plan, takes nothing off.

**Points of judgement.**
- Active Continuum plan ending one year or more after the termination effective date (365 days or more): 5.0 percent off.
- Active plan ending on the termination effective date or up to 364 days after it: 2.5 percent off.
- Active plan ending the day before the termination effective date or earlier: nothing.
- No active Continuum Backup & Recovery plan: nothing.

**Hypothetical case.** Termination effective 2025-10-31; Continuum term ending 2026-10-31 (365 days): 5.0 percent off; ending 2026-03-31: 2.5 percent off.
